meta.description: Authored, not executed. Mirrors the proven ROVER portal crawl mechanism (VEHICLE_DATA_FETCH.md 'ROVER portal crawl mechanism'): prime session → CSRF token → grid POST (sorted by last-updated) → per new/changed approval, GET VTADetails → POST the page HTML to the app's /api/rover/ingest, which does the extraction + gating. n8n fetches; the app parses + gates. Set the credentials, $env vars and the captured base64SecureConfiguration before enabling (see README.md). Cadence: weekly.

nodes.name: Prime session (cookies)
nodes.notes: GET the directory page to obtain ARRAffinity / Dynamics365PortalAnalytics / __RequestVerificationToken cookies. Enable the HTTP Request node's cookie jar so they carry into the next requests (n8n persists cookies per-execution when 'Response → Include Headers' + a shared session are configured).

nodes.name: Get CSRF token HTML
nodes.notes: Public, no auth. Returns an HTML fragment containing the __RequestVerificationToken value.

nodes.name: Fetch grid page

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ base64SecureConfiguration: $env.ROVER_GRID_SECURE_CONFIG, sortExpression: 'rvr_publishedlastupdatedate DESC', search: null, page: 1, pageSize: 100, filter: null, metaFilter: null }) }}

nodes.notes: POST the grid query. base64SecureConfiguration is the per-list blob embedded in the directory page (reusable from a fresh session). Tim captures it once and sets it as the ROVER_GRID_SECURE_CONFIG env var (see README). Page through (page: 1..n) until records are older than the high-water mark.

nodes.name: Filter: towing categories + newer than high-water mark
Fetch VTADetails HTML
nodes.notes: Server-rendered HTML embeds every document inline as base64 in downloadPdfFile('<b64>','<name>.pdf'). We DON'T parse it here — the app does. One GET per new/changed approval; keep it polite (one at a time).

nodes.name: POST → app /api/rover/ingest
nodes.notes: The app extracts the inline PDFs, parses + archives, and lands per-variant PENDING candidates. Returns { ok, vtaNumber, variantsCreated, variantsRefreshed, amendment }. Trailing slash + the bearer token are required (trailingSlash:true → a 308 hop otherwise).

nodes.name: Alert if crawler looks broken
nodes.notes: TRUE branch → wire to Tim's alerting (email / Slack / a webhook). Left unwired here (authored-only).

main.node: Filter: towing categories + newer than high-water mark
